scripts.start:site: rm -rf dist .parcel-cache && parcel serve *.html blog/**/*.html --dist-dir dist
scripts.start: npm run build:blog && npm run start:site
scripts.dev: npm run build:blog && concurrently -k -n BLOG,SITE -c blue,green "npm:watch:blog" "npm:start:site"
scripts.build: npm run build:blog && rm -rf dist .parcel-cache && parcel build *.html --dist-dir dist --public-url https://marych.website/
